title: "NextEnergy Solar Analysis"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Load the necessary library
library(ggplot2)

# Create a data frame with historical data
# NextEnergy Solar's fiscal year ends in March.
# Gas prices are annual averages for the corresponding fiscal year.
data <- data.frame(
  Fiscal_Year_End = as.Date(c(
    "2015-03-31", "2016-03-31", "2017-03-31", "2018-03-31", "2019-03-31", 
    "2020-03-31", "2021-03-31", "2022-03-31", "2023-03-31", "2024-03-31"
  )),
  NextEnergy_Revenue_mGBP = c(16.70, 42.90, 62.48, 65.17, 65.04, -14.52, 56.58, 143.70, 66.03, 8.82),
  UK_Gas_Price_p_therm = c(48, 38, 48, 50, 55, 35, 45, 150, 200, 100)
)

# Create a scatter plot of revenue vs. gas price
ggplot(data, aes(x = UK_Gas_Price_p_therm, y = NextEnergy_Revenue_mGBP)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "NextEnergy Solar Revenue vs. UK Gas Price (2015–2024)",
    x = "Average UK Gas Price (pence/therm)",
    y = "NextEnergy Revenue (£m)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Build the linear regression model
model <- lm(NextEnergy_Revenue_mGBP ~ UK_Gas_Price_p_therm, data = data)

# Display a summary of the model
summary(model)

# Add the regression line to the scatter plot
ggplot(data, aes(x = UK_Gas_Price_p_therm, y = NextEnergy_Revenue_mGBP)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Linear Regression Model: NextEnergy Revenue vs. UK Gas Price",
    x = "Average UK Gas Price (pence/therm)",
    y = "NextEnergy Revenue (£m)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# Shift gas prices forward by 1 year (to align last year's gas price with this year's revenue)
data$Lagged_Gas_Price <- c(tail(data$UK_Gas_Price_p_therm, -1), NA)

# Remove the last row (2024) since it has no known gas price for 2025
lagged_data <- na.omit(data)

# Fit the regression model using lagged gas prices
lagged_model <- lm(NextEnergy_Revenue_mGBP ~ Lagged_Gas_Price, data = lagged_data)

# Display model summary
summary(lagged_model)

ggplot(lagged_data, aes(x = Lagged_Gas_Price, y = NextEnergy_Revenue_mGBP)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "NextEnergy Revenue vs. Previous Year's UK Gas Price",
    x = "UK Gas Price (Previous FY, pence/therm)",
    y = "NextEnergy Revenue (£m)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
